method.join: trace order with strictly increasing seq; one pending corrupt_decision closed by next bot_decision
method.choice_action_validation: corrupt_choice has no action field; compare bot_decision.action == corrupt_hex and params.hex_id == corrupt_choice.hex_id

bootstrap.unit: seed cluster; all seating permutations within a seed stay together

method.potential_leader_impact: signed delta between selected candidate and the best leader-impact candidate among maximum-impact candidates; upper bound, not a simulated policy
